title: Creekside Getaway-Acre of Land, Close to DT & Lake
description:
Welcome to your new favorite getaway! 

Have fun with the whole family at this newly renovated, 4 bedroom home in the heart of Gallatin, TN. Located on an acre of land with a creek running through the backyard, it's the perfect place to relax and unwind while still being just a short drive away from the music city action! 

This airbnb offers a close proximity to:

Historic Downtown Gallatin: 3 minutes
Downtown Nashville/Broadway: 35 minutes
Old Hickory Lake: 5 minutes

The space
Comfort meets luxury in this chic home decorated with your vacation in mind. Newly renovated home in the middle of everything Gallatin has to offer! 

Inside the kitchen, you'll find all the silverware, pots, pans and plates plus your basic seasonings. Because sometimes we just want a home-cooked meal, right? You'll also find coffee for the next morning so you can get your vacation started on the right foot.  

The bedrooms are furnished with memory foam mattresses and plenty of pillows. There is nothing worse than traveling and getting a terrible nights sleep so we made sure to get the best of the best for each bed! 

The master bedroom has a king bed, private bathroom, fireplace, and smart tv.

The living room is furnished with a smart flat-screen tv where you'll be able to binge all your favorite shows on our comfy couch. 

In terms of amenities, we've got you covered too! You'll have access to small, yet important, things like: An iron, blow dryer, towels, soap, and more.

The backyard is what Tennessee dreams are made of. An acre of land with beautiful trees, a fire pit, and backs up to a creek of running water - it's so peaceful you'll understand what those country songs are about.

Large driveway for free parking. 

Board games are provided for the family as well as a pack n play if requested!

Guest access
You'll have access to the entire house and backyard.
